title: Bayesian Synthetic Control Methods
eligible_reason: Synthetic control with a single treated unit and a single adoption date. Not a TWFE DiD.
design_notes: Methods paper proposing Bayesian synthetic control estimators (horseshoe, spike-and-slab, Bayesian lasso etc.), compared with standard SCM, panel data (Hsiao-Ching-Wan) and elastic net in simulations and in one application: Washington state soda tax (2010) using state-level weekly Nielsen retail scanner data. Washington is the only treated unit.
screener_notes: Not eligible: synthetic control with one treated state. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. Application uses Nielsen retail scanner data (licensed); estimation code is in Web Appendix B per the text.
